rows.commentary: 0.1: Azmatullah Omarzai starts with a massive in-swinger from middle stump that drifts past Saif Hassan, forcing the keeper to scramble left as the umpire extends his arms for a wide.
0.1: Saif Hassan gets off the mark by toe-ending a full, fading delivery wide of cover for a sharp single.
0.2: Omarzai loses his radar again, spilling another bonus run down the leg side for an easy wide to the left-hander.
0.2: Omarzai finds a subtle nip back into the left-hander, allowing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to gently tuck it into the leg side.
0.3: Tanzid Hasan Tamim cops a thick inside edge on a full delivery aimed at middle, sending it safely wide of mid-on.
0.4: Pushing off the front foot, Tanzid Hasan Tamim blocks a probing good-length ball firmly into the cover region.
0.5: Tanzid Hasan Tamim showcases a crisp front-foot drive wide of mid-off, prompting Rashid to launch into a brilliant sliding stop.
0.6: Charging down the pitch, Saif Hassan miscues a flat-batted stroke straight toward mid-off.
1.1: Ahmadzai mirrors his teammate's erratic start, spraying a wide well past the tramline that leaves Tanzid Hasan Tamim grasping at air.
1.1: Yamin Ahmadzai searches for his radar early to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, straying too far down the leg-side for the umpire's outstretched arms to signal a wide.
1.1: Ahmadzai finds an immediate correction, pinning a good length on off-stump that Tanzid Hasan Tamim firmly drives toward mid-off.
1.2: Yamin Ahmadzai strikes the breakthrough as extra bounce catches the edge of Tanzid Hasan Tamim's bat, safely pouched by Rahmanullah Gurbaz behind the stumps.
1.3: Yamin Ahmadzai rattles Soumya Sarkar's stumps, leaving the batsman scoreless and plundering back-to-back wickets in a blistering start.
